title: MENUS BOUNCE ON OPEN
why: His Q47 (2026-10-18): livelier menu motion, with bounce, overshoot about 6 to 10 percent, never ignoring a press. Windows and their rows rise on an ease-out-back curve (8 percent past home), the tab slide uses it, and the confirm pulse is 8 percent (was 6).
now: Menus open with a small bounce and buttons pop a little harder when pressed.
